label: Fairy Tail
description: Natsu Dragneel and his friends take on dangerous jobs for the chaotic but beloved Fairy Tail mage guild.

vocab.context: Magic permeates every corner of Fiore — and Fairy Tail's mages use it with more chaos than anyone else in the kingdom.
Natsu fights for his nakama above all else — the word that defines every heroic act in Fairy Tail.
Natsu's Dragon Slayer Magic channels pure flame — he even eats fire to replenish his power.
Lucy's Celestial Spirit Magic summons the twelve zodiac spirits — each tied to a golden star-shaped key.
Erza's Heavenly Web Slash cuts through the sky — her blade techniques are as vast as the horizon.
Juvia is a water-body mage — her emotions for Gray manifest as rain that soaks the battlefield.
Gajeel's Iron Dragon Slayer Magic lets him turn his body into iron and devour metal to power up.
Laxus wields lightning as his Dragon Slayer element — the Thunder God Tribe follows him loyally.
Fairy Tail is a story about friends who become family — the bonds forged in the guild hall outlast any battle.
Fairy Tail's members fight from the heart — raw emotion is often the catalyst for their most powerful moments.
Natsu's power has no ceiling — every time he hits a wall, emotion alone pushes him through it.
Lucy's dream is to become a full-fledged mage — she records every adventure in a novel she hopes to publish.
Erza puts her body on the line to protect her guild — her armour is both shield and statement.
Dragons ruled the ancient world and taught their magic to chosen humans — leaving a legacy that shapes the entire plot.
Erza Re-Quips dozens of swords in an instant — each one suited for a specific battle scenario.
Guild members take jobs posted on the request board — from escorting merchants to hunting dark mages.
Every arc is a new adventure — Fairy Tail never stays still long enough to be comfortable.
The bonds between Fairy Tail members are the show's emotional engine — they snap tight under pressure, never break.
Victory for Fairy Tail usually comes at the very last moment, powered by sheer stubbornness and love.
Betrayal hits hardest in Fairy Tail because the bonds are so deep — it always carries personal history.
Friendship is the series' beating heart — it's the reason Natsu gets back up every single time.
Erza wears the Fairy Tail mark as a badge of pride — she'd rather die than disgrace the guild.
Mavis sacrificed her physical existence to protect Fairy Tail — the first master's love endures for centuries.
Natsu's limit is not a ceiling — it is a floor he keeps raising with every impossible fight.
Erza's traumatic past in the Tower of Heaven defines her drive — she faces it rather than run.
Fairy Tail's seven-year disappearance leaves the guild mourned and thought dead — memory keeps them real.
Dragon Slayer magic amplifies with emotion — the stronger Natsu feels, the hotter his fire burns.
Natsu's vow to find Igneel drives him across continents — a promise made to a father who is also a dragon.
When Erza sets her resolve, no enemy has ever successfully talked her out of it.
Fairy Tail earns its emotional moments — sadness over lost comrades hits harder because of the joy that preceded it.
Even against Acnologia's annihilation, hope persists — the Dragon Slayers combine to defy the impossible.
Natsu and END share the same fate — one must end the other, yet Natsu refuses to accept that script.
Every Fairy Tail mage will throw themselves in front of danger to protect their guild.
Fairy Tail's strength is trust — members fight harder knowing their guildmates are watching their back.
Fairy Tail isn't just a guild — it's the family that the lonely, the broken, and the lost find their way to.
Jobs range from D-rank escort missions to S-rank quests that only the guild's elite can legally take.
Natsu's magical power grows with emotion — his reserves are almost bottomless when nakama are at stake.
Acnologia's Eternal Flare spell would cause total annihilation — the Dragon Slayers are the only counter.
Zeref tried to seal away his own power to stop the endless deaths his presence caused — unsuccessfully.
Dragon Slayer Magic is passed from dragon to human — a sacred inheritance that takes years to perfect.
Overusing Dragon Force causes massive magical exhaustion — even Natsu needs rest after pushing that hard.
Every Fairy Tail member bears the guild's crest somewhere on their body — the mark of belonging.
Zeref is cursed with immortality and uncontrolled mass-killing magic — he has lived in agony for centuries.
Zeref's immortality is not a gift — it is a punishment that forces him to watch everyone he loves die.
Dragon Force transforms a Dragon Slayer's body, covering it in scales and multiplying their power.
Natsu's Fire Dragon's Roar leaves a trail of destruction — the guild's repair bills are legendary.
Lucy treats her Celestial Spirits as partners, not tools — her contracts are built on mutual respect.
Celestial Spirits are beings from another realm — Lucy's bond with them is one of the series' warmest threads.
Combining two Dragon Slayer elements produces fusion techniques with amplified destructive power.
Natsu's fighting spirit never dims — even half-dead, he rises and charges the strongest enemy in the room.
When a comrade is hurt, Natsu's anger converts directly into magical firepower.
Fairy Tail earns its tears — the emotional payoffs hit because the characters have paid for them.
First Master Mavis is described as a fairy of light — her presence is warmth even centuries after her death.
Exceeds like Happy spread their wings to carry their Dragon Slayer partners over impossible terrain.
Fairy Tail disbands — then triumphantly revives. The guild's resilience mirrors the spirit of its members.
The S-Class Promotion Trials push mages to their absolute limit — few pass, all are changed.
Dark guilds operate in the shadows — Grimoire Heart and Tartaros push Fairy Tail to its darkest moments.
The Kingdom of Fiore officially recognises guilds — making magic both a livelihood and a legal profession.
Fairy Tail is the most chaotic, most destructive, and most beloved guild in the Kingdom of Fiore.
Dragon Slayer Magic was taught by dragons to kill dragons — and to eat their element for power.
END is Zeref's most powerful demon — and the secret other self hidden inside Natsu Dragneel.
Natsu is the Fire Dragon Slayer, Fairy Tail's most reckless mage, and Zeref's younger brother.
Lucy left her noble family to chase her dream — she finds a new one in the form of Fairy Tail.
Erza Scarlet — Titania, Queen of the Fairies — is Fairy Tail's most feared and most respected S-Class mage.
Gray's Ice-Make magic and constant rivalry with Natsu fuel some of the series' best comedy and best battles.
Happy is Natsu's blue cat companion — an Exceed who can sprout wings and carry Natsu into the sky.
Zeref is the most feared dark mage in history — and Natsu's older brother, who created him as a demon.
Acnologia is the black dragon that devours all magic — the ultimate enemy who surpasses even Zeref.
Igneel is the Fire Dragon King — Natsu's foster father who hid inside him for years to fight Acnologia.
Laxus is the Thunder Dragon Slayer and Makarov's grandson — arrogant at first, then a true pillar of the guild.
Mavis is Fairy Tail's First Master — a genius strategist whose soul remains bound to the guild she founded.
Dragon Force is the ultimate Dragon Slayer transformation — dragon scales appear on the body and power soars.
Re-Quip lets Erza switch armour and weapons mid-battle in an instant — over 100 sets at her command.
Lucy's Celestial Spirit Magic summons zodiac spirits via golden keys — treating them as friends, not weapons.
Gray sculpts any shape from ice in an instant — from shields to weapons to intricate traps for enemies.
The Grand Magic Games determine Fiore's strongest guild — Fairy Tail returns from seven years of absence to compete.
Dark guilds operate outside the law — Grimoire Heart, Oración Seis, and Tartaros are Fairy Tail's greatest enemies.
The Magic Council regulates guilds and mages — they have a complicated relationship with Fairy Tail's constant destruction.
Exceeds are cat-like beings from Edolas who can grow wings — Happy and Carla are the most prominent ones.

meanings.en: Etherious (demon from the Books of Zeref)
meanings.es: Etherious (demonio de los Libros de Zeref)

vocab.context: Etherious are demons Zeref created — END is the most powerful among them, and secretly Natsu himself.
S-Class is the highest guild rank — Erza, Laxus, and Gildarts hold it; Natsu perpetually chases it.
